verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms three.js ships a GLTFLoader (threejs-docs-4), covering the glTF pipeline, but there is no mention of FBXLoader or USD/USDZ support anywhere in the pack. Community commentary even suggests that loading non-native formats (e.g. .obj) was surprisingly painful and not well-integrated into core, undermining the 'imports cleanly' claim for formats beyond glTF. missing for 10: FBX loader documentation/evidence, USD/USDZ loader documentation/evidence, independent confirmation that these imports work cleanly without workarounds.
